simple.meaning: בַּחִין (bachîyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a watch- tower of besiegers.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בַּחִין (H971) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 23:13, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּחִין (H971) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בַּחִין (H971) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בַּחִין (bachîyn) / H971 is traced through Isaiah 23:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
